notes.title: Patch for Unity Games!
notes.content:
Good day!

Today I bring you some improvements, patches, bugfixes. Shout out to Stephen for the reports!

 Other smaller fixes and QOL changes

notes.title: Fixes for Unsupported Languages
notes.content:
Good Day!

Thank you for your support, I was able to fix these issues due to two reports that were sent to my email :) I really appreciate that.

- Now defaults to English for unsupported languages
- Fixed crashes on start-up that some people reported

notes.title: More Languages!
notes.content: Added localisation in multiple languages. The default language is based on the operating system's language, but you can change it in the context menu.

notes.title: More Features!
notes.content:
Good Day!

Thank you all for the kind reviews and feedback, I am so happy to know that JustScroll is bringing value to you. The last post outlined some features that the community would love to have, this update delivers on those requests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770893/5f9f8da61bb35efe0461d09dc52de3a918e28e84.png

New Features:

 Adjustable volume scroll amount
 Option to run with admin permissions to support apps that run as admin
 Simpler instructions in the "How to use" menu

All of these new features are accessible by right-clicking the tray icon.

IMPORTANT! - If using an older version, make sure you run the app through steam at least once after updating in order to finalize the update.

Keep on Scrolling! :)
- Ed

notes.title: Community Feedback!
notes.content:
Greetings!

This week JustScroll received amazing feedback and great suggestions. Some people enjoyed using the app, some said that they can no longer live without it (most?) and some gave constructive feedback and valuable information on how to improve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770893/6571a6aa1a73860df3aace3dd6753d982081027f.png

Summary of the feedback and requested features:

 Needs adjustable hotkey
 Needs adjustable volume scroll amount
 Needs a notification on steam app exit (to say it's still active in the tray)
 Needs to launch with admin permissions, as currently it does not work with full screen apps that run as admin
 Lacks support for apps that block the Windows key, like Rocket League, works when set to borderless
 Needs the ability to skip music
 Should allow to adjust separate application's volumes like in Volume Mixer
 Function to switch audio outputs
 Simpler instructions from the "How to use" menu


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770893/36978858d92985eb6ed0d36e55a96971419d00e9.png

All of these and more will be the target improvements in the upcoming patches.

Thank you all for taking the time to try JustScroll, give some feedback and suggestions on how to improve. 

Keep on Scrolling! :)
- EdsWindowsMods
